svg.title: Kong in Kubernetes — full architecture from CDN to pods
svg.desc: Traffic flows from users through CDN, Load Balancer, Kong Ingress Controller, then to microservice pods inside the Kubernetes cluster

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Who are the users hitting the API?')
sendPrompt('What does the CDN do before Kong in Kubernetes?')
g.text: cache static assets · DDoS protection · TLS termination

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the cloud load balancer do in front of Kong?')
g.text: AWS ALB / GCP GLB · SSL cert · port 443→80

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the Kong Ingress Controller and what does it do in Kubernetes?')
sendPrompt('What is the Kong control plane in Kubernetes hybrid mode?')
sendPrompt('What are KongIngress CRDs and how do they configure Kong in Kubernetes?')
sendPrompt('Where does Kong store its config in Kubernetes?')
sendPrompt('How does Kong route to a specific microservice in Kubernetes?')
sendPrompt('Can Kong load balance between multiple Kubernetes services?')
sendPrompt('How does Kong handle routing to multiple microservices?')
sendPrompt('How does Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling work with Kong?')
sendPrompt('How does Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling work with Kong?')
sendPrompt('How does Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling work with Kong?')
sendPrompt('How does Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling work with Kong?')
sendPrompt('How does Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling work with Kong?')
sendPrompt('How does Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling work with Kong?')
sendPrompt('What is HPA in Kubernetes and how does it scale pods automatically?')
g.text: scales pods up/down based on CPU / RPS — Kong health checks detect changes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do Prometheus and Grafana work with Kong in Kubernetes?')
sendPrompt('What does Grafana show for Kong metrics in Kubernetes?')
sendPrompt('How does distributed tracing work with Kong in Kubernetes?')

svg.text: Outside cluster — CDN + cloud LB (you don't manage these)
Kong layer — ingress, auth, rate limiting, routing
Your services — Node.js pods. Kong proxies to these. Never exposed directly.
